title: [FLINK-38759][runtime] Refactor application mode with PackagedProgramApplication
body:
## What is the purpose of the change

This pull request refactors Application Mode and use PackagedProgramApplication instead of ApplicationDispatcherBootstrap.


## Brief change log

- Use PackagedProgramApplication to bootstrap the Dispatcher in Application Mode
- Update StreamContextEnvironment, ExecutionPlan and Dispatcher to associate jobs with their owning application


## Verifying this change

This change added tests and can be verified as follows:

- Added test that validates the behavior of the Dispatcher bootstrap
- Updated integration tests for end-to-end Application Mode execution
- Manually verified the change by running in Standalone Application Mode


## Does this pull request potentially affect one of the following parts:

  - Dependencies (does it add or upgrade a dependency): (no)
  - The public API, i.e., is any changed class annotated with `@Public(Evolving)`: (no)
  - The serializers: (no)
  - The runtime per-record code paths (performance sensitive): (no)
  - Anything that affects deployment or recovery: JobManager (and its components), Checkpointing, Kubernetes/Yarn, ZooKeeper: (no)
  - The S3 file system connector: (no)

## Documentation

  - Does this pull request introduce a new feature? (no)
  - If yes, how is the feature documented? (not applicable)
